scripts.check:no-js: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=fs.readdirSync('src',{recursive:true}); const js=files.filter(f=>/\.(js|jsx|cjs|mjs)$/.test(f)); if(js.length){console.error('Plain JavaScript files are not allowed in frontend/src:',js); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.build: npm run check:no-js && npm run typecheck && vite build
